title: US-08 DFD: present recipe details

flows.label: Owned complete recipe with ordered ingredients/steps
Owned recipe id and server view timestamp
Committed new or refreshed view record
200 complete recipe details or access/not-found error

rules: This functional view combines detail presentation 5.1 and history maintenance 5.2 as aggregate process 5.0; US-14 shows their internal exchange.

All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
Details include title, supplied ingredients, ordered steps, minutes, calories per serving and serving count. UI labels generated cooking time and calories as estimates.
Malformed provider output is rejected during generation in US-07/US-09, before any recipe can be read here.
A successful detail response includes the history upsert behavior specified by US-14.
No inventory write occurs: recipe, shopping, favorite and history actions never deduct or restock fridge ingredients.
